label: card-mum-myturn
brief: A candid, warm photo of a folded white greeting card standing on a wooden living-room table, soft natural daylight from a window, a couch softly blurred in the background. The card face is hand-lettered in casual black marker, large, filling the card edge to edge, split exactly as: "Dear Mum," then "you looked after" then "my teeth." then "My turn." - and near the bottom of the card face, much smaller, one line: "The good German stuff. x" Spell every word exactly, nothing else on the card. Lying on the table in front of the card: the LACALUT aktiv toothpaste tube, an EXACT match of the attached real packshot - real red/white German packaging, label facing the camera, true real-world size, with a thin red gift ribbon tied around its middle in a small, slightly imperfect hand-tied bow, resting on a small piece of brown kraft gift-wrapping paper freshly torn open with edges curling naturally. Everything relit to the soft daylight with natural contact shadows on the wood. It must look like a real photo someone snapped of a gift they prepared, never a polished advertisement. No people, no hands, no other text or logos in the scene.
